comparison.objective: PR-2061 mixes layered liquid in two open tubes without spilling; the candidate sets and locks gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2061 tests controlled tube motion, liquid mixing, spill avoidance, and rack insertion, not threaded tool use.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2061 requires both solutions mixed, no spill, both tubes racked, released, and still; the candidate requires a retained 90° stop over repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: Fluid mixing under a spill constraint is unrelated to mechanical stop calibration and countertorque.
